items.title: Willie J. Humphrey Interview, 1979-11-29
items.q: But everybody had to hand out like Henry Clay.

ctx.x: How do you find being on the road now different than say when you were working on the ...

Well it's a whole lot different. Like in what way? It's a whole lot different in many ways. Like in what way? It's more expensive, but you get, it's convenient, it's much more pleasant than before. Like traveling especially with the Japanese jurisdiction where he's been handling, he's been treating the musicians very nice. So I've traveled on the roads before, I've worked with Miller and I wasn't getting a whole lot of money. But everybody had to hand out like Henry Clay. We had a valet who used to travel with…
Do you think you'll keep on traveling a lot?
